method.weighting: uniform diagnostic, not official tsys final calibration

acceptance: Reauthenticate complete archive, all 14 spatial/time metadata gates. Inspect installed dysh exact call sites for getspec/average/alignment. Independently compare frozen VFRAME and negative Astropy heliocentric radial correction for historical natural field at actual observation times (20 m/s tolerance, independent of spectral samples). For tutorial IF0 both pols, calibrate individual ON/OFF integrations and compare dysh uniform time average against independently calculated channel-index average and independently frame-labelled diagnostic average on common interior support. Aggregate RMS differences and temporal residual energy only; no data arrays, line profiling, candidate processing or detector comparison. No claim of reversible averaging, exact frame alignment, generality, or production calibration; retain original native bytes. If physical frame check fails, do not calculate frame-aligned diagnostic. No threshold relaxation.
